scope: 36 month Dec 2021-Nov 2024 source panel; first 12 months train only, next 24 expanding-window evaluations

model_specification.target: originally reported core PCE one-month percent change, one decimal
model_specification.cpi_only: OLS with intercept and current-month core CPI; expanding prior-month training
model_specification.candidate: OLS with intercept, current-month core CPI and PPI final demand less foods, energy and trade services; expanding prior-month training
model_specification.feature_selection_status: retrospective exploratory, not preregistered or independently held out

loss_differences_candidate_minus_cpi_onl.bootstrap_design: 10,000 paired circular moving-block resamples, 3-month blocks, seed 20261119; exploratory uncertainty only

limits: Original publication/receipt times are not authenticated; source release schedules and original-release archive figures are used.
One-decimal PCE target and component-series mismatch limit resolution.
No historical BEA source map or weights are used; this tests one broad PPI aggregate, not a component nowcast.
The 24 scores are rolling historical errors, not an untouched future or live trading record.
No consensus, XAU/USD bid/ask, slippage, or trading return is measured.
